info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Servicing Servicing Mandates-spec
info.description: The Servicing Mandate Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about servicing mandates within the banking sector. This API is designed for financial institutions and service providers to efficiently retrieve data regarding various servicing mandates, which are essential for maintaining regulatory compliance and managing client relationships. Typical consumers include banking personnel and application developers looking to integrate mandate data into their systems for reporting or operational purposes. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their operational capabilities and ensure timely access to critical mandate information.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the details of a specific servicing mandate, providing essential information for reference or further processing.
